features.name: 3-axis gimbal stabilization
features.notes: Counteracts vehicle rotation using IMU data, supports zyx/zxy Euler conventions

features.name: Gimbal command angle tracking
features.notes: Tracks desired roll/pitch/yaw angles from gimbal_command_rpy_deg topic

features.name: Multi-agent parametric launch
features.notes: Spawns per-vehicle gimbal nodes from vehicles.yaml + gimbal_config.yaml

features.name: World-frame LOS rate gimbal controller
features.notes: Ports iris_ma6 analytical gimbal controller to ROS2. Accepts normalized az/el rate commands, integrates in world frame, computes body-frame joints via IK. Multi-agent launch via multi_agent_los_rate.launch.py
